responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE hardening passes that duplicate and cross-check conditional computations to detect fault-induced control-flow corruption. One pass hardens boolean-producing comparisons and another hardens branch conditions by creating detached operand copies, emitting complementary comparisons, splitting blocks and EH edges as needed, and inserting conditional traps when the original and reversed conditions disagree; both passes are gated by the hardening options and update SSA/CFG after instrumentation.
